name: sit_down
text: A person stands with a bench right behind the legs, bends the knees and lowers the hips straight back onto the bench, back upright, head up. The hands come to rest on the thighs.

scene.note: from standing at the approach (0.48 m in front) to the sunk seated pose; hips keyed back over the seat mid-way so the torso leans ~30 deg, not 60
